# ilo

> ilo — the token-minimal programming language AI agents write. Prefix notation, strongly typed, verified pre-run. Designed so the agent is the primary author, not a human.

ilo is designed for one audience: AI agents that author code. Every design decision is evaluated against a single metric — total tokens from intent to working code. Six principles govern the language: Token-Conservative, Constrained, Self-Contained, Language-Agnostic, Graph-Reducible, and Structured Compiler-to-Agent Surface.

## Quick start

```bash
# Install
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ilo-lang/ilo/main/scripts/ensure-ilo.sh | bash

# Write and run
echo 'add a:n b:n>n;+a b' > hello.@
ilo run hello.@ add 3 4    # outputs: 7
```

## Core docs

- [Manifesto](https://ilo-lang.ai/docs/manifesto/): The six principles and why they exist. Read this first.
- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/SPEC.md): Full language specification (2,675 lines). Syntax, types, builtins, error codes, CLI.
- [ai.txt](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/ai.txt): Token-minimal agent spec (23 lines). The entire language in a single prompt-sized file.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/SKILL.md): Bootstrap skill — 8 modular sub-skills served from the binary via `ilo skill get <name>`.

## Skills (modular, load only what the task needs)

- [ilo-language](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-language.md): Syntax, types, guards, match, pipes, records, Results
- [ilo-builtins-core](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-builtins-core.md): List, map, HOFs
- [ilo-builtins-io](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-builtins-io.md): File I/O, HTTP, JSON, env, time, process
- [ilo-builtins-math](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-builtins-math.md): Math, stats, bitwise
- [ilo-builtins-text](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-builtins-text.md): String ops, regex, formatting
- [ilo-tools](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-tools.md): MCP + HTTP tool declarations
- [ilo-errors](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-errors.md): ILO-XXXX error code reference
- [ilo-edit-loop](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-edit-loop.md): The repair cycle, JSON diagnostics, common fixes
- [ilo-engines](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-engines.md): VM, JIT, AOT execution backends
- [ilo-agent](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-agent.md): Agent integration, skill discovery, output contract
- [ilo-examples](https://github.com/ilo-lang/ilo/blob/main/skills/ilo/ilo-examples.md): Curated example index

## Key concepts

- **Prefix notation**: `+a b` not `a + b`. Nesting: `+*a b c` = `(a*b)+c`. Eliminates parentheses, saves tokens.
- **Shape-only typing**: no borrow checker, no lifetimes. Values are RC-managed. The type checker enforces shape only.
- **Results not exceptions**: `R n t` type, `~v`=Ok, `^e`=Err. `!` auto-unwraps, `??` nil-coalesces.
- **Guards**: flat early returns. `=b 0 ^"zero"` returns error if b is zero.
- **Structured diagnostics**: every error is `ILO-XXXX` JSON with code, span, hint. One JSON object per line.
- **Serv mode**: `ilo serv` — long-lived JSON stdin/stdout loop, zero process-spawn overhead.

## CLI surface

```
ilo run file.@ [fn] [args]      run a program
ilo check file.@ --json         verify without running
ilo run file.@ --json           wrap output as {"ok":v} / {"error":...}
ilo skill list                  list available skill modules
ilo skill get <name>            get a skill module's content
ilo graph file.@ --json         extract call graph as JSON
ilo constrain                   export grammar as JSON state machine
ilo constrain --mode masks      export per-state logit masks
ilo compile file.@ -o out       AOT compile to standalone binary
ilo serv                        long-lived JSON loop on stdin/stdout
ilo explain ILO-T004 --json     structured error explanation
```
